dogecoin.text: #Dogecoin is riding on popularity, celebrity endorsements, the backing of the top brass, and universal acceptance. Such promotions either become epics like #StarWars or end up in a bubble, says @PujaTayal

#ElonMusk imagines a future where you can travel to #Mars in a reusable rocket just like you can travel abroad in a plane. If travelling to Mars sounds ambitious, there is a crazy $Doge project, informs @PujaTayal

"#ElonMusk - I admire his work with #PayPal, #Tesla, and #SpaceX. But the #Dogecoin project is something I would keep in a neutral stance. I would suggest you put your paper money in a more realistic investment like electric vehicles." - @PujaTayal

#Cryptomania comes every three to four years and makes only a few people rich, while millions of people lose money. You might have made money in the crypto mania... good for you. For those who haven't - @PujaTayal tells you how to avoid losing it.

#crypto #dogecoin #Bitcoin

What can happen in 20 days? Ask a #Dogecoin trader. It took 20 days for the coin to surge 137% from $0.369 on April 18 to $0.875 on May 8. It took 20 days for Dogecoin to drop back to $0.36. Will Dogecoin go up again? @PujaTayal has a different take on it.

#Dogecoin investors are posting memes around “HODL” and buying the dip. Patience is not quite the strength of #Redditors. While one can’t be sure about the coin, patience with #Hive could be rewarding, says @PujaTayal
